records.evidence: 三书互证：《旧唐书·卷四十》武州条明载天宝元年改为武都郡且口数15313与源记录完全一致，《新唐书·卷四十》记景福元年（892）始更名阶州，结合《通典·卷一七六》确认742年实为武州武都郡（源 Jie Zhou 系用晚唐州名）。
records.evidenceEn: Period name (Wudu Jun, historically 武州, renamed Jie Zhou only in 892 CE) verified for 742 CE against Old Book of Tang · juan 40 (pop. 15,313), New Book of Tang and Tongdian. Source Jie Zhou retained for search.
